title: fix: Use the correct method from MetadataCapture for grpc endpoints
summary:
## 🔗 Related Issue

Addresses #2854 

---

## 📝 Summary

This PR fixes one of the bugs identified in #2854 related to `gRPC` service registration

```sh
# Terminal 1, boot the server
MCPGATEWAY_UI_ENABLED=true MCPGATEWAY_ADMIN_API_ENABLED=true MCPGATEWAY_GRPC_ENABLED=true AUTH_REQUIRED=false python -m mcpgateway.cli

# Terminal 2, register a service
curl -X 'POST'   'http://localhost:4444/admin/grpc'   -H 'accept: application/json'   -H 'Content-Type: application/json'   -d '{
  "name": "caikit.runtime.SampleLib.SampleLibService",
  "target": "localhost:8989",
  "description": "string",
  "reflection_enabled": true,
  "tls_enabled": false,
  "visibility": "public"
}'
```
